dayTheme.title: Water stewardship at our school
dayTheme.why: One school-wide problem, how our school uses and protects water, links the Codex schoolday lessons (monitoring water loss, engineering a container cover). The four draft.6 lessons keep their own sealed contexts (seed measurement, melting ice, a seed library text, the county map). The theme is context, never a replacement for each subject's objectives.

scope: Founder direction (2026-10-23, in session with CoS): there is one track, the full STEM day. The six draft.6 lessons are extended into the day and the gaps are filled with Content Factory schoolday lessons (Codex, 4.0.0-schoolday.1). There is no separate six-lesson pilot. Draft.6 packages stay sealed and byte-identical.
pilotBoundary: Every draft period runs only through the ungraded /learn/preview path with progressStorage=MEMORY, and only after the founder authorizes each exact package hash. The learning-preview flag is OFF. No grade, mastery, promotion, assignment or learning-history write.
sequenceMinutesBasis: Minute splits are Chief of Staff planning estimates of each scene, not measured. They must be replaced by timed rehearsal evidence (gate G6) before any claim that a lesson fills a 45-minute period.

binding.activity: Question of the day posted in every classroom: 'How could our school keep seed safe through the rainy season?' Learners return to it in P6.
